subject: mittens-portrait
name: Mittens and Owner — Watercolor Portrait Sketch

styleSelection.reason: Watercolor portrait sketch with fine lines and light washes: preserve bright paper highlights across the background, cat chest, and lit forehead, build transparent warm ochre/sienna and cool grey-sepia planes through five light-to-dark bands, and anchor focal features with delicate opening graphite and crisp closing sepia ink.

open-paper-ground.reason: Leave the upper-center and top-right background as clean bare paper with soft edges around the cat ears and curly hair.

cat-ginger-crown-ears.reason: Layer pale yellow ochre and burnt sienna washes for the tabby forehead and ear interiors while keeping crisp eye catchlights and green-gold iris tones.

cat-back-tabby-coat.reason: Build warm ochre, raw sienna, and burnt sienna stripes over a continuous pale warm base wash along the back and shoulder.

cat-white-muzzle-chest.reason: Preserve the bright white paper of the cat's muzzle, whiskers, and chest bib with only whisper-light warm-cool transitions at the ruff.

human-curly-hair-mass.reason: Build the dark charcoal-sepia curly hair from a soft grey-brown undertone to connected shadow glazes and directional curl accents.

human-lit-forehead-cheek.reason: Keep the lit forehead and nose bridge bright while laying translucent warm ochre and sienna blush washes across the temple and cheek.

human-eyes-brows-nose.reason: Reserve tiny eye catchlights and restate dark brows, upper lash lines, irises, pupils, and nostril shadows on dry paint.

human-beard-jaw-shadow.reason: Lay soft warm-umber and Payne's-grey washes over the beard, moustache, lower lip, and chin shadow where the head leans against the cat.

reserves.reason: cat right eye catchlight glint next to vertical slit pupil
cat upper whisker bright highlight glint
